quarterly_data.quarter: Tempus AI press release: Tempus Presents Data Demonstrating AI-Enabled Pre-Screening (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Tempus presented at ESMO 2026 a study of its AI-enabled H&E pathology pre-screening panel for advanced non-small cell lung cancer: across 60,459 advanced NSCLC cases from 56,969 patients, the panel achieved greater than 80% sensitivity across all 12 biomarkers assessed, exceeding 90% for several. The study was conducted through an ongoing collaboration between Tempus and Pfizer. The panel remains in development and is not intended to replace molecular or IHC testing.
quarterly_data.figure: 60,459 cases; 56,969 patients; greater than 80% sensitivity across 12 biomarkers
